entries.complaint: This string uses EPANET's own 'tag' attribute on junctions/pipes, a concept unrelated to this suite's own 'Label' vocabulary (lpn_tool_labels / lpn_labels_heading_node, already shipped as 'Étiquettes'). The obvious French word for 'tag' is also 'étiquette', which would collide with our own Label concept on the same page and risk a reader thinking the .inp import note is about map labels. I rendered EPANET's tag as 'balise' instead to keep the two concepts visually distinct in French, but there is no glossary entry for EPANET tags and no other lpn_ string exercises this word, so I have no incumbent to confirm against.
readings: Use 'balise' for EPANET's tag attribute, reserving 'étiquette' for this suite's own Label concept (chosen)
Use 'étiquette' for both, accepting the collision since EPANET tags are not shown anywhere on this page yet
